name: Sticky right sidebar
purpose: Right sidebar that stays in view while the content scrolls, from 900 px up. It scrolls on its own when taller than the screen. Under 900 px it is a normal block under the content. A :has() rule clears overflow hidden on the OceanWP wrappers, which would otherwise stop sticky.

inputs.name: main
inputs.description: Page content region. Pass the page body HTML.

notes: Sticky fails if any ancestor sets overflow hidden, auto or scroll. The :has() rule handles the OceanWP wrappers #outer-wrap, #wrap and #main. Other ancestors need the same fix.
Set --sc-sticky-top to the height of a fixed header, in px.
verified_in: headless Chrome/Edge at 360 px and 1280 px
